title: Double-line tangent-cone transition and the cubic on its support
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m,k)$ be a commutative normal Nagata local domain of dimension $2$ defining a rational singularity [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-per-rational-surface-singularity]. Suppose its maximal-ideal-adic completion is normal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $A$ is not regular [def-weil-regular-scheme], and $A$ is Gorenstein, meaning that its injective dimension as an $A$-module is finite. Put $X=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathfrak m}(\operatorname{Spec}A)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Choose minimal generators $x_1,x_2,x_3$ of $\mathfrak m$ and a nonzero homogeneous quadratic polynomial $q\in k[t_1,t_2,t_3]$ such that $t_i\mapsto x_i\bmod\mathfrak m^2$ induces $k[t_1,t_2,t_3]/(q)\cong\operatorname{gr}_{\mathfrak m}A$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring]. Assume $q$ is a nonzero scalar times a square. One can choose the minimal generators so that $x_3^2=\sum_{i\leq j\leq l}a_{ijl}x_ix_jx_l$. In these coordinates the exceptional fibre is a doubled line with underlying line $C\cong\mathbf P^1_k$ [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. The homogeneous cubic $H(U,V)=\overline a_{111}U^3+\overline a_{112}U^2V+\overline a_{122}UV^2+\overline a_{222}V^3$ is nonzero. Every singular point of $X$ lies in its zero set on $C$; a singular point at which the new tangent quadratic polynomial is a scalar square is a multiple closed zero of this cubic (multiplicity means the exponent of its irreducible homogeneous factor). There is at most one such point; it is $k$-rational.
